h:
我的“组合工作流程”的更简单版本，删除了第 3 阶段和第 4 阶段步骤（重采样器、细节器、4->16MP 放大器），有利于生成 4MP 结果的多模型工作流程。

这是一个非常简化的版本https://civitai.red/models/2149956/我删除了很多节点，只是为了保留简单的初始生成和初始升级器（类似于在没有第 3 和第 4 阶段的情况下运行更大的工作流程）。很多使用细节都在较大的工作流程中，没有复制到这里，一些注释可能包含刚刚从较大的工作流程中复制的内容）

0. 使用各种切换↘️快速选择（选择末尾的箭头将直接带您到节点/子图）。

1. 选择用于生成图像的模型，调整其参数以匹配您的设置。

2. 决定是否要表演txt2img（输入提示并获取图像）或图像2图像（使用提示和基础图像来生成基于两者的新图像）。使用时图像2图像确保提供图像，设置预期的基本图像分辨率（以 MP 为单位）并设置去噪.

3. 决定是否要编写提示或使用图像并让 QwenVL 编写提示（您仍然可以添加到主提示区域中的提示）。使用 QwenVL 时，加载图像并选择预设了解您需要的响应类型。

4. 决定是否要使用 Qwen 来优化图像生成之前的最终提示。执行此操作时，请决定要生成的提示类型：标签、叙述或两者兼而有之。

5. 单击“运行”，图像将以您选择的参数开始生成。取决于批量大小您将生成一组图像。最后的提示是可见的。初始生成后，一个简单的高分辨率修复会将图像升级到 4MP。

的额外的从原始工作流程中添加一些其他功能：

  • 详细说明：Stage3 的细节设计师使用手动蒙版（和用于修复的绘图）选择来制作通用细节设计师。

  • 详细信息_sam3：第 3 阶段的详细信息具有自动检测功能（基于 SAM3），可根据提供的提示自动对找到的面罩进行详细信息处理。

  • 重采样器：Stage3 的初始和细节重采样器。

  • 通量重采样器：Stage3 的 Flus 重采样器。

o.en:
Simpler version of my "Combined Workflow" that removes Stage 3 and 4 steps (resamplers, detailers, 4->16MP upscalers) in favor of a multi-model workflow that generates 4MP results.

This is a very simplified version ofhttps://civitai.red/models/2149956/where I have removed a lot of nodes just to keep the simple initial generation and the initial upscaler (similar to running the much larger workflow without Stage 3 and 4). A lot of the details on usage are in the larger workflow and were not copied here, and a few notes might contain content that is just copied from the larger workflow)

0. Use the various toggle ↘️ to quick select (the arrows at the end of the selection will bring you to the node/subgraph directly).

1. Select a Model to generate an image with, adapts its parameters to match your setup.

2. Decide if you want to performtxt2img(enter a prompt and get an image) orimg2img(use a prompt and a base image to generate a new image based on both). When usingimg2imgmake sure to provide an image, set the expected base image resolution (in MP) and set adenoise.

3. Decide if you want to write your prompt or use use an image and have QwenVL write a prompt (you can still add to the prompt in the main prompting area). When using QwenVL, load an image and select thepresetfor the type of response you need.

4. Decide if you want to use Qwen to optimize the final prompt before the image generation occurs. When doing so, decide on the type of prompt you want generated: tags, narrative or both.

5. Click "Run", the image generation will start with your selected parameters. Depending on thebatch_sizeyou will have a set of image generated. The final prompt is viewable. After the initial generation, a simpleHiResFixwill upscale the image to 4MP.

Theextrasadd some other features from the original workflow:

  • detailer:Stage3's detailers made generic detailer with manual mask (and drawing for inpainting) selection.

  • detailer_sam3:Stage 3's detailers with automatic detection (SAM3 based) to automatically detail the mask found with the provided prompt.

  • resampler:Stage3's Initial and Detailer resamplers.

  • Flux_resampler:Stage3's Flus resampler.
